Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In Step 10, the WebSurfer agent failed to extract the correct nationality from the Wikipedia page it had just opened. The JSON-LD metadata explicitly stated `"nationality": "English"`, which is factually incorrect for Tracy Flannigan (who is American, as confirmed by the film description "2004 American documentary film" seen in earlier steps and the search snippet "Tracy Flannigan is American" visible in later search results). Instead of correcting the error or cross-referencing with the contradictory text on the same page (which described her as residing in Los Angeles and working in US festivals), the agent accepted the machine-generated JSON-LD data as a definitive fact. This error propagated because the agent did not critically analyze the conflict between the structured data (English) and the unstructured text/content (American/US-based) presented in the same source, leading to an incorrect final conclusion based on flawed data extraction.
